ui.title: Jiedong Zhang · Robotics & Embodied AI
ui.description: Jiedong Zhang: shape-aware motion planning, robot learning and computational physics.
ui.heroTag: Motion Planning · Robot Learning · Computational Physics
ui.heroLead: From the shape of a robot to the path it can follow.
ui.heroAbout: I work on shape-aware motion planning and robot learning, with a background in applied physics and a cross-university minor in mathematics. I enjoy building algorithms, connecting hardware and testing ideas on real robots.
ui.heroCurrent: Research intern at Shanghai Jiao Tong University’s MINT Lab and HKUST (Guangzhou)’s PAIRS Lab, working on robot learning, hardware integration and active vision.
ui.piano: Classical piano — a continuing interest alongside research and engineering.
ui.fieldnotesIntro: Building, sharing and learning with other makers.

research.title: Shape-Aware Motion Planning
research.body: Collision-aware planning that accounts for the robot’s full shape, with an interest in articulated systems and coupled base–payload motion.

research.title: Robot Learning
research.body: Reinforcement-learning experiments, teacher–student distillation and history-based estimation for locomotion and whole-body control.

research.title: Vision–Language–Action
research.body: Investigating how gaze information and visual compression affect VLA behavior, alongside dataset preparation, model fine-tuning and real-robot evaluation. Exploring coordination between high-level decisions and low-level execution.

research.title: Computational Physics
research.body: Physics simulation and reproducible workflows that connect published methods, executable experiments and analysis figures.

projects.name: Active Vision & Hierarchical VLA
projects.body: Studying how gaze information and visual compression affect VLA behavior, and exploring coordination between high-level visual decisions and low-level action policies. Led dataset collection and cleaning, Qwen-based fine-tuning and data generation, and Piper training and evaluation. Current work focuses on matching training inputs to deployment inputs and recording visual observations, policy outputs and robot feedback for reproducible comparisons.
projects.caption: Coin-task data-collection replay: paired external and close-up camera views.

projects.name: Shape-Aware Motion Planning
projects.body: Reproducing SVSDF collision-free motion planning from FAST Lab open-source code. Completed SE(2) planning for a simulated quadrupedal robot; extending the method to SE(3) quadruped trajectories. Current research examines how geometric clearance, orientation and local smoothness should guide trajectory refinement, alongside planning-guided multi-task reinforcement learning for policy generalization.
projects.caption: SE(3) planning test environments: geometry previews of four scene layouts.

projects.name: OPENARM · VR Teleoperation
projects.body: Contributed to cross-network teleoperation linking Meta Quest 3 and OPENARM, alongside Jetson Orin deployment and robot-side integration. The engineering work covers connection renewal, session handover, transport diagnostics and command/feedback logging. Ongoing validation examines both communication continuity and physical execution, with a focus on observable, repeatable robot experiments.
projects.caption: OpenArm platform reference image · Enactic / OpenArm official repository.

projects.name: ATEC 2026 · Team ATEpi
projects.body: Led reinforcement-learning experiments and algorithm pipeline design. Reproduced HIMLoco, Extreme Parkour and whole-body control. Two-stage teacher–student distillation achieved 84% task success, while history-based parameter estimation yielded a 0% base-fall rate in the evaluated runs. Scored 36/36 in obstacle traversal; placed 16th overall on the online L1 leaderboard, with a Track 2 score of 52.

projects.name: Anisotropic Complex-Plasma Simulation
projects.body: Developed a Taichi/PyTorch simulation engine for anisotropic complex plasma and reproduced published research. Built experiment-data archiving tools with memU and the Claude-Scientist backend. Completed a national-level undergraduate innovation project and graduation thesis, supporting ISS data-processing work.
projects.caption: A simulation result from my public project repository: two-temperature dynamics in a reproduction of Ivlev et al., PRX (2015).

projects.name: Agentcraft · AR / AI Glasses
projects.body: Designed and implemented a 2D-to-3D interaction pipeline using Tripo3D, 3DGS and AI glasses. Integrated WorldGen and World Labs tools and APIs to validate two prototypes. The team received the Technical Innovation Award at Rokid Spatial Joy 2025.
projects.caption: Agentcraft’s trophy and certificate for the Rokid Spatial Joy 2025 Technical Innovation Award, received in January 2026.

projects.name: lazy-paper · Research Knowledge Garden
projects.body: An open-source research tool that connects paper reading, question development, a searchable literature library and experiment notes. Its pipeline produces bilingual analyses with figures and source references; the knowledge-garden view maps relationships between papers and experiments. The public repository includes the code, usage guide and example outputs.
projects.caption: Knowledge-garden interface: connecting papers, questions and experiments. Screenshot from the public project repository.

experience.body: Work on active visual tracking, including visual information compression and combining multiple camera views into a single stream to improve VLA robustness to environmental disturbances. Collected, cleaned and organized the dataset; used Qwen-4B for fine-tuning and data generation, and trained and tested PI0 / PI0.5 on Piper. Preparing a co-first-author submission to RSS 2027, contributing to manuscript writing, real-robot validation and figures.

experience.org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University · MINT Lab
experience.body: Adapted starVLA to benchmark tasks, calibrated an extended seven-axis SO101 arm, and collected data and ran training and inference on Piper. Deployed a Jetson Orin and connected Meta Quest 3 teleoperation to OPENARM across separate local networks. Contributed all figures, later-stage writing and detailed review to Evo-RL, submitted to ICRA 2027. Also participated in Learn the Task, Not the Schedule, on reducing spurious coupling in bimanual data, submitted to ICLR 2027.
Supported AR technical sharing, campus liaison and XR collaboration. Discussed developer and user needs at S-Startup, Google DevFest and AdventureX.
experience.caption: Rokid campus ambassador appointment · September 2025–July 2026.

experience.body: Helped organize hackathons through the NJU Maker Club, coordinated sponsorship resources, and supported collaboration in a maker community of more than 500 members.
